title: the published store and client tools carry claim provenance, and the store its own proof
intention: The two tools devices publish, trouble's store and db_domain's client, each carry claim_provenance in their charter, and trouble's store carries a proof of its own beside its code that measures the tool alone.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-claim-provenance (devices/db_domain/tools/client, devices/trouble/tools/store) and inspector-new-finding-proofs-exist (devices/trouble/tools/store). The store's proofs sit at the trouble device, so the tool reads as unproved at its own address, and its falsifier's 'never writes' clause was measured nowhere.
how: Add claim_provenance {role: cc-read, what: cc-read, why: akien} to both tool charters. New proof cairn/devices/trouble/tools/store/proofs/test_the_store_tool_only_reads.py: (1) the inspector's claim_provenance sieve answers [] on the store tool; (2) live() and listing() over a scratch store leave every path, size and mtime_ns unchanged, and store.py's AST calls no write_text, write_bytes, unlink, rename, replace, mkdir, rmdir, rmtree or open in a write mode; (3) live() over an absent store raises FileNotFoundError and live() over a seeded store answers its top rows, not cleared/. The store charter's proof and invoke fields name it first. test_client.py gains a tooth calling the sieve on the client.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's claim_provenance sieve returns [] on cairn/devices/trouble/tools/store and on cairn/devices/db_domain/tools/client
cairn/devices/trouble/tools/store/proofs/ holds a proof, so proofs_exist returns [] on the store tool
live() and listing() over a scratch store change no path, size or mtime under it, and store.py calls no write, delete, rename or mkdir
live() over an absent store raises, and over a seeded store answers exactly the top-level tickets and none from cleared/

decisions.text: D1: marks are role cc-read, what cc-read, why akien: each why quotes Akien and the measurements around the quote are CC's reading. The store proof measures only the tool (RULE 1); the device's own proofs stay where they are and still prove the readers. The client tooth rides test_client.py beside its three.

measured.saw: inspector-new-finding-claim-provenance at 2 components and inspector-new-finding-proofs-exist at devices/trouble/tools/store; 73 charters carry claim_provenance and 3 do not
measured.how: python3 -m cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector; grep -rL claim_provenance over cairn/ intention+why.json
